event.descriptionText:
What if your AI agents worked for you—not Big Tech?
As AI becomes increasingly autonomous, a critical question emerges: who owns and controls these intelligent systems? Join Amazon Web Services and Yat Siu for an exclusive evening exploring how Web3 infrastructure enables a fundamentally different future—one where users own their agents, their data, and their digital destinies.
🔥 30-Minute Fireside with Yat Siu
Panel - Monetizing Your AI: Agents as Digital Assets
​Event Schedule (3.5 Hours)

Guest check-in and welcome
Early networking opportunity
6:00 PM - 6:15 PM | Opening Remarks
Event overview and housekeeping
Introduction to the evening's theme
6:15 PM - 6:45 PM | 🔥 Fireside Chat with Yat Siu (30 minutes)
6:45 PM - 7:30 PM | Panel Discussion: Monetizing Your AI - Agents as Digital Assets
Topics:
✨ True Ownership: Agents working for users, not platforms
🔐 Data Sovereignty: User control over agent learning and data sharing
💰 Value Capture: Agents transacting on behalf of users
🌐 Interoperability: Cross-platform agent functionality
🔍 Transparency: Verifiable AI behavior on blockchain
7:30 PM - 9:00 PM | Networking
Refreshments
Connect with builders and founders
Informal discussions
Who Should Attend?
This intimate gathering is designed for builders, founders, and visionaries shaping the next generation of intelligent systems:
Explore the intersection of agentic intelligence and digital ownership:
✨ True Ownership: Your agents work for you, not platform shareholders
🔐 Data Sovereignty: You control what your agents learn and share
💰 Value Capture: Agents can transact on your behalf with your assets
🌐 Interoperability: Agents that work across platforms, not locked in silos
🔍 Transparency: Verifiable AI behavior on immutable ledgers

event.name: Upgrade the Internet: Presented by Succinct, Celestia, and Conduit
event.descriptionText:
Upgrade the Internet: A Three-Day Building Experience with Succinct, Celestia, and Conduit
Apply to be a builder: https://forms.gle/FTJTtxBKu8FafUtV8 
The Internet is rapidly changing. Blockchains and ZK are becoming performant and developer friendly, and it's time to create user-verifiable applications.
We're bringing together builders who want to use frontier ZK and the emerging modular and rollup stacks to upgrade the Internet, from crypto to beyond. This isn't just another hackathon—it's three days of focused building, learning, and collaborating with some of the most innovative teams in crypto.
Come build applications such as attested media, verifiable hardware, proof of reserves, and more. We'll have a party on the last day. 
The Experience
You can join as a builder (in one of two tracks: the open track or the Mammothon track) or attend talks and evening discussions. Bring your own project ideas or find inspiration in conversations with builders.
For Builders
You'll have direct access to engineers and researchers from Succinct, Celestia, and Conduit. We've created room for both structured guidance and independent exploration. Fill out the builder form here: https://forms.gle/FTJTtxBKu8FafUtV8. You can participate in one of two tracks: 
Open track: In the open track, you can work on your own ideas or any of our request for projects (https://succinctlabs.notion.site/rfps). To participate in the open track, the only requirement is that you make use of one of Succinct's, Celestia's or Conduit's stacks. 
Mammothon track: Celestia is hosting a monthlong Mammothon for builders with up to $250,000 in prizes (https://mammothon.celestia.org/). Apply to this track if you're already working on a Mammothon project. 
Prizes and Judging
There'll be $10K in additional prizes available for the best projects at Upgrade the Internet. 
First place: $5000
Second place: $2500
Third place: $2500
The Succinct, Celestia, and Conduit teams will judge projects and disburse prizes at their discretion.  
For Attendees
We'll have talks, demos, and evening discussions on the future of verifiability in crypto and in the world. You'll learn about emerging challenges and see how teams are approaching their projects. We'll also have a party on the last day. 
Schedule
February 26
10am: Talks from the Succinct, Celestia, and Conduit teams
11am: Hacking begins
6pm: Dinner and ZK in Crypto Session (https://lu.ma/ele4qkfz)
February 27
9am: Hacking continues
1pm: Kosuke July Hata (Roc Camera) and Lasha Andatze (Rarimo Protocol) 
3pm: zkTLS Special Session (https://lu.ma/xvumlnkq)
4pm: Sid Gandhi (Payy)
5:30pm: Aayush Gupta (ZK Email)
February 28
9am: Hacking continues
4pm: Demos and prizes
6pm: House Party (https://lu.ma/3vxc2fzn)
-----------------------------------------
About Succinct
Succinct's mission is to prove the world's software via SP1, the fastest production-ready ZK virtual machine for developers and a decentralized prover network. 
About Celestia
Celestia is a modular blockchain that powers unstoppable applications with full-stack customizability. With over 80 chains in production, Celestia enables expressive applications at a global scale, ranging from instant private payments to fully on-chain mobile gameplay.
About Conduit
Conduit is the end-to-end rollup platform. As the market leader by TVL, TPS, Mgas/s, and number of mainnets deployed, we power everything from games to DEXs to DeFi ecosystems. The best onchain teams customize, deploy, and scale their rollups on Conduit.

​We're taking over the PBW Connect Lounge. 
Fireblocks are exclusively taking over the Connect Lounge on Wednesday 15th April from 3:30 - 5:30 pm.
Here, we'll be focusing all about the topic of Institutional Yield, and why it matters now.
You can expect a expert panel on "The Institutional Yield Imperative", and a live demo that will give you the blueprint to enable your business to help your customers "Trade Everything", taking you through "A Roadmap for Compliant Yield Products".
And, of course, our door is open for meetings and networking. You can see who from the team will be in Paris and schedule a meeting with them here. We'll also have coffee and light refreshments for your afternoon pick-me-up.
​We look forward to seeing you and the ecosystem for an afternoon of networking with the biggest names in the blockchain and digital asset space.
Register your interest now to reserve your spot. See you in Paris at the Fireblocks House at the Connect Lounge!
P.S. Don't forget, you will need your PBW pass to access the Fireblocks House!
Agenda:
15:30 - 15:35 | Welcome Remarks
Speaker: Alexandre Chessé, Head of Sales EMEA - Banking & TradFi, Fireblocks
15:35 - 16:05 | Panel: The Institutional Yield Imperative
The digital asset landscape is evolving fast — tokenized assets, on-chain yield, and rising client expectations are creating major opportunities, but also mounting complexity. Navigating MiCA, DORA, and fragmented European compliance frameworks is now a prerequisite to compete. This panel unites builders, infrastructure providers, and market-makers to debate the real pressure points and what a credible product roadmap looks like for institutions and exchanges trying to win on yield.
Speakers:
Adam Levine, SVP, Corporate Development & Partnerships, Fireblocks; CEO, Fireblocks Trust Company (Moderating) 
Paul Frambot, Co-Founder & CEO, Morpho
Zane Glauber, Global Head of Distribution, Galaxy Digital
Ramin Kader, Head of Markets & Institutions, Bitvavo
16:15 - 16:45 | Live Demo: "Trade Everything" – Bringing Compliant Yield Products to Market
This practical product roadmapping session walks attendees through how financial institutions and exchanges can bring compliant, yield-bearing products to market quickly using Fireblocks and Dynamic's combined infrastructure. This session is structured around a realistic go-to-market scenario: "You want to offer your clients yield on digital assets. What does your stack look like, and how fast can you move?"
Speaker: Alice Ollivier, Sales Engineering Manager, Core, Fireblocks
16:45 - 17:30 | Meetings & Networking with the Fireblocks team and PBW ecosystem
17:30 | Close of Connect Lounge

​​​⏰ 3:30pm to 5:30pm CEST

What is Bitcoin Block Fest?
Bitcoin Block Fest, brought to you by Bitcoin x AI Startup Lab, is a premier series of events celebrating Bitcoin x AI innovation, collaboration, and community.
